description: This file declares the interface for iterating over references in a Git repository. It includes a macro defining usage options for 'for-each-ref'-related commands, and declares the core function 'for_each_ref_core' which processes command-line arguments to enumerate references with various filtering and formatting options.

methods.name: for_each_ref_core
methods.description: Core function implementing the logic for iterating over references in a Git repository, supporting various options for filtering and formatting.
